roadmap.title: MediaTrack Class
roadmap.outcome: Create a reusable model for media tracks.
roadmap.notes: First challenge completed in Visual Studio; introduced MediaTrackModel with calculated display and duration properties, optional constructor values, and a ToString() override. Console testing also highlighted a Unicode rendering issue for some artist names.

roadmap.title: Library Scanner
roadmap.outcome: Scan folders recursively and discover supported media files.
roadmap.notes: Implemented recursive library scanning with a HashSet for supported extensions and a dictionary for extension counts. Required some guidance identifying the appropriate .NET directory-scanning and path APIs.

roadmap.title: Karaoke File Pairing
roadmap.outcome: Match MP3 and CDG files into karaoke pairs.
roadmap.notes: Implemented directory-aware MP3/CDG pairing with case-insensitive extension handling. Including the directory in the pairing key prevents identically named files in different folders from being incorrectly matched.

roadmap.title: Media Type Detection
roadmap.outcome: Classify discovered files by media type.
roadmap.notes: Introduced MediaFileType and MediaTypeDetector, using a switch expression and normalized file extensions to classify audio, karaoke graphics, and unsupported files.

roadmap.title: File Validation
roadmap.outcome: Validate file paths before processing.
roadmap.notes: Reused MediaTypeDetector through a project reference and introduced descriptive FileValidationStatus results rather than simple boolean validation.

roadmap.title: Media Library
roadmap.outcome: Manage an in-memory collection of media tracks.
roadmap.notes: Introduced MediaLibraryCollection with an encapsulated List<MediaTrackModel>, read-only public access, overloaded removal methods, and case-insensitive file-path lookup.

roadmap.title: Media Library Queries
roadmap.outcome: Search the media library using reusable LINQ queries.
roadmap.notes: Introduced reusable LINQ query methods returning MediaTrackModel sequences, with case-insensitive exact artist matching and partial title/file-path searching kept separate from console presentation.

roadmap.title: Media Library Filtering
roadmap.outcome: Filter tracks by karaoke status and duration.
roadmap.notes: Practised LINQ query syntax through MediaLibraryFilterService, filtering karaoke/music tracks and duration ranges without modifying the original collection.

roadmap.title: Track Sorting
roadmap.outcome: Sort tracks using LINQ and custom comparison logic.
roadmap.notes: Implemented sorting with both LINQ method/query syntax and a custom ArtistTitleComparer using case-insensitive artist and title comparison; sorting returns new sequences without changing the original collection.

roadmap.title: Duplicate Detection
roadmap.outcome: Detect duplicate tracks using custom equality rules.
roadmap.notes: Implemented artist/title duplicate detection using HashSet<MediaTrackModel> and a custom IEqualityComparer<MediaTrackModel>, treating matching artist/title values as duplicates regardless of path or character casing.

roadmap.title: Media Library Processor
roadmap.outcome: Combine the foundational library services into a processing workflow.
roadmap.notes: Milestone 1 combined duplicate detection, filtering, sorting, and presentation into a staged workflow, demonstrating how outputs from small reusable services can be composed without duplicating their logic.

roadmap.title: Media Metadata Model
roadmap.outcome: Represent embedded and technical media metadata.
roadmap.notes: Implemented MediaMetadata as an immutable-style record with a required file path, nullable metadata fields, init-only properties, value equality, and with-expression support.

roadmap.title: Read Embedded Audio Metadata
roadmap.outcome: Read embedded tags and technical audio properties.
roadmap.notes: Introduced TagLibSharp for embedded tags and technical audio properties, with FileInfo supplying file-system metadata. Initial verification used MP3 files while additional supported formats were left for later testing.

roadmap.title: Filename Metadata Fallback
roadmap.outcome: Recover missing metadata from supported filename formats.
roadmap.notes: Added filename fallback for Artist - Title and TrackNumber - Artist - Title formats while preserving available embedded metadata. Unrecognised filenames fall back to the filename without its extension as the title.

roadmap.title: Metadata Resolution
roadmap.outcome: Resolve the best available metadata from multiple sources.
roadmap.notes: Centralised metadata precedence so embedded values take priority over filename-derived values, with null, empty, and whitespace-only strings treated as missing.

roadmap.title: Metadata Reader Interface
roadmap.outcome: Isolate third-party metadata reading behind an application-owned interface.
roadmap.notes: Introduced IMetadataReader and EmbeddedMetadata, isolated TagLibSharp inside TagLibMetadataReader, and refactored MediaMetadataScannerService to depend on the application-owned abstraction while preserving existing scanner behaviour.

roadmap.title: Metadata Resolution Tests
roadmap.outcome: Add automated tests around metadata resolution and fallback behaviour.
roadmap.notes: Introduced the xUnit test project with 15 passing tests covering metadata precedence, filename fallback, parameterized cases, exceptions, fake metadata readers, and temporary-file handling.

roadmap.title: Scan Result Model
roadmap.outcome: Represent successful and failed media scans consistently.
roadmap.notes: Introduced MediaScanResult with an explicit success flag, nullable metadata for failed scans, and read-only warning/error collections so scan outcomes can be represented without mixing data with console presentation.

roadmap.title: Exception Handling & Error Reporting
roadmap.outcome: Continue scanning when individual media files fail.
roadmap.notes: Introduced MediaScanService to convert recoverable file-level exceptions into structured failed results while allowing batch scanning to continue; non-fatal missing metadata is represented through warnings.

roadmap.title: Scan Statistics
roadmap.outcome: Generate scan, metadata-quality, and karaoke-pairing statistics.
roadmap.notes: Added reusable scan summaries covering success/failure rates, warnings, extension grouping, metadata completeness, and existing karaoke pairing results. Scan results are materialised before calculating multiple statistics.

roadmap.title: Metadata Library Milestone
roadmap.outcome: Integrate metadata scanning into a complete library workflow.
roadmap.notes: Milestone 2 integrated discovery, metadata reading and resolution, error reporting, karaoke pairing, and scan statistics. The original real-library run discovered 859 supported files, scanned 714 metadata-capable files successfully, and identified 145 karaoke pairs.

roadmap.title: Configuration File
roadmap.outcome: Move library configuration out of hard-coded application values.
roadmap.notes: Introduced AppConfiguration and ConfigurationLoader using System.Text.Json, replacing a hard-coded library location with JSON configuration integrated into the Metadata Library Milestone.

roadmap.title: Configuration Validation
roadmap.outcome: Validate loaded configuration separately from file loading.
roadmap.notes: Separated configuration loading from validation through ConfigurationValidator, distinguishing file/deserialization failures from invalid configuration values.

roadmap.title: Multiple Library Sources
roadmap.outcome: Configure multiple music, karaoke, and mixed library sources.
roadmap.notes: Expanded configuration from one library path to multiple Music, Karaoke, and Mixed sources with enabled/disabled state, readable JSON enum values, case-insensitive duplicate-path validation, and graceful handling of unavailable drives.

roadmap.title: Source-Specific Scan Rules
roadmap.outcome: Apply different karaoke-processing rules to music, karaoke, and mixed sources.
roadmap.notes: Introduced source-specific karaoke rules so Music, Karaoke, and Mixed sources are processed differently. Mixed sources preserve standalone MP3 files as valid music while identifying MP3/CDG pairs and unmatched CDG files; six focused tests were added. The service and tests were later extracted into dedicated projects during Challenge 033.

roadmap.title: Playlist Model
roadmap.outcome: Represent an ordered in-memory playlist.
roadmap.notes: Introduced MediaPlaylist with Guid identity, ordered read-only track access, add/remove/clear operations, and 6 passing tests. Duplicate entries are deliberately allowed to support repeated tracks and different recordings or versions.

roadmap.title: M3U Playlist Import & Export
roadmap.outcome: Import and export playlists using the M3U format.
roadmap.notes: Implemented M3U import/export with absolute and relative path handling, comment/blank-line support, order preservation, and 11 automated tests. Generated playlists were manually verified in both VLC Media Player and Winamp.

roadmap.title: Playback Queue Manager
roadmap.outcome: Manage an editable ordered playback queue.
roadmap.notes: Introduced PlaybackQueue with enqueue, queue-next, peek, dequeue, remove, and clear operations. Twelve tests cover ordering, mutation, and empty-queue behaviour, with a console demo used for manual verification.

roadmap.title: Playback History & Play Counts
roadmap.outcome: Track playback events, play counts, and last-played times.
roadmap.notes: Introduced PlaybackHistoryEntry and PlaybackHistoryManager for in-memory playback events, newest-first history, play counts, and last-played timestamps. Paths are preserved as recorded but queried case-insensitively.

roadmap.title: Favourites
roadmap.outcome: Store favourite tracks and persist them between runs.
roadmap.notes: Introduced FavouriteManager with duplicate-safe, case-insensitive path state and FavouriteStore for JSON persistence. State management and file persistence remain separate responsibilities.

roadmap.title: Smart Lists
roadmap.outcome: Create dynamic track collections using reusable rules.
roadmap.notes: Introduced predicate-based SmartListRule, SmartList, and SmartListService with validation, ordered rule management, read-only access, and AND matching. Empty smart lists return all supplied tracks.

roadmap.title: Advanced Search & Filter Rules
roadmap.outcome: Generalise smart lists into a reusable filtering and search system.
roadmap.notes: Generalised Smart Lists to SmartList<T> and SmartListRule<T>, added configurable All/Any matching and composite rules, and introduced reusable MediaTrackRules. The generic rule engine remains independent of media-specific filtering.

roadmap.title: Search & Playlist Milestone
roadmap.outcome: Compose the in-memory library, search, playlist, favourites, and playback features into an end-to-end workflow.
roadmap.notes: Milestone 3 composed configuration, scanning, source rules, metadata mapping, the media library, Smart Lists, sorting, favourites, playlists, M3U resolution, playback queue, and playback history into an end-to-end workflow. LibrarySourceRulesService was extracted into a reusable project, path-based state was made case-insensitive, and the full solution reached 178 passing tests. Whole-library persistence was deliberately deferred to Challenge 034.

roadmap.title: JSON Library Persistence
roadmap.outcome: Save and reload a modest media library without rescanning.
roadmap.notes: Introduced versioned JSON persistence for MediaLibraryCollection using dedicated DTOs and a persistence mapper, keeping serialization concerns separate from domain models. JsonMediaLibraryStore supports save/load workflows, missing-file handling, validation, unsupported-version detection, human-readable JSON, and complete round-trip persistence while preserving track data and ordering.

roadmap.title: SQLite Fundamentals
roadmap.outcome: Learn relational persistence using a small standalone SQLite database.
roadmap.notes: Introduced SQLite through Microsoft.Data.Sqlite using a standalone Songs table with an auto-incrementing primary key. SqliteDatabase implements parameterized INSERT, SELECT, UPDATE, and DELETE operations, maps query results into SongRecord objects, and uses temporary databases for isolated automated tests. A console demo exercises the complete CRUD lifecycle before the full media library schema is introduced in Challenge 036.

roadmap.title: Media Library Database Schema
roadmap.outcome: Design tables for tracks, sources, playlists, history, and related data.
roadmap.notes: Introduced the relational SQLite schema for library sources, tracks, karaoke companion files, playlists, playlist entries, and playback history. The schema uses primary and foreign keys, uniqueness and validation constraints, explicit indexes, case-insensitive path uniqueness, one-to-zero-or-one karaoke file relationships, cascading cleanup for dependent data, and restricted track deletion when playlist references remain. The schema is stored as an embedded SQL resource and initialized through MediaLibraryDatabaseInitializer, with 21 isolated SQLite tests verifying schema creation, constraints, relationships, indexes, and delete behaviour.

roadmap.title: Database Data Access Layer
roadmap.outcome: Keep SQL and database concerns separate from library business logic.

roadmap.title: Persist Scanned Tracks
roadmap.outcome: Store scan results and resolved metadata in SQLite.

roadmap.title: Database-Backed Search
roadmap.outcome: Search and filter a large library efficiently from SQLite.

roadmap.title: Incremental Library Scanning
roadmap.outcome: Scan only new or changed files.

roadmap.title: Library Reconciliation
roadmap.outcome: Detect deleted, moved, or unavailable tracks and reconcile stored records.

roadmap.title: File System Watcher Library Updates
roadmap.outcome: React to library file changes without requiring a full manual rescan.

roadmap.title: Database & Persistence Testing
roadmap.outcome: Verify database persistence and incremental scanning behaviour.

roadmap.title: Persistent Library Milestone
roadmap.outcome: Deliver a database-backed media library that survives restarts and updates efficiently.

roadmap.title: Async Library Scanner
roadmap.outcome: Run slow library scanning work without blocking the application.

roadmap.title: Scan Progress Reporting
roadmap.outcome: Report useful scan progress to callers.

roadmap.title: Cancellation Support
roadmap.outcome: Allow long-running scans to be cancelled safely.

roadmap.title: Application Events & Delegates
roadmap.outcome: Communicate application state changes through events.

roadmap.title: Service Interfaces
roadmap.outcome: Define stable contracts around major application services.

roadmap.title: Dependency Injection
roadmap.outcome: Compose application services using a dependency injection container.

roadmap.title: Performance Profiling
roadmap.outcome: Measure and investigate performance bottlenecks in realistic workflows.

roadmap.title: Broader Unit & Integration Testing
roadmap.outcome: Expand automated coverage across application service boundaries.

roadmap.title: Application Architecture Milestone
roadmap.outcome: Consolidate the application into a maintainable and testable architecture.

roadmap.title: Playback State Model
roadmap.outcome: Represent player state and valid playback transitions.

roadmap.title: Player Commands
roadmap.outcome: Implement commands that control player state.

roadmap.title: Karaoke Track Model
roadmap.outcome: Represent the related audio and graphics components of a karaoke track.

roadmap.title: Karaoke Playback Coordination
roadmap.outcome: Coordinate karaoke audio and graphics playback.

roadmap.title: MVVM & ViewModels
roadmap.outcome: Introduce a presentation architecture suitable for a desktop application.

roadmap.title: Desktop Library UI
roadmap.outcome: Build a desktop interface for browsing and searching the media library.

roadmap.title: Now Playing & Karaoke UI
roadmap.outcome: Display and control current playback through the desktop UI.

roadmap.title: Mini Karaoke Player Milestone
roadmap.outcome: Deliver a small end-to-end desktop music and karaoke player.
